children.name: h
children.text: When off, the StatefulSet is scaled to zero (Suspended). Data is preserved.

children.name: h
children.text: Seconds the operator waits for the template’s stop sequence to finish before scaling the pod down. Range 0–600; defaults to 30. No effect when the template declares no stop sequence.

children.name: h
children.text: Per-server overrides for the template’s readiness/liveness/startup probe timing. The probe action is inherited from the template.

children.name: h
children.text: Scale the server to zero when nobody is playing, and bring it back on a schedule or on demand. The world is saved first and the data volume is kept.

children.name: Switch Label
children.text: Wake the server when a player connects

children.name: Helper
children.text: While the server sleeps, a small pod holds its ports and wakes it when a player tries to join. Costs one extra pod per sleeping server. Games that only use UDP wake on the first attempt; the player joins on retry.

children.name: text
children.text: A game that reports no player count will never sleep.

children.name: text
children.text: A wake window never restarts a server you stopped by hand.
